ja366:1.1: Madhuvaṇṇaṃ madhurasaṃ madhugandhaṃ visaṃ ahu, Gumbiyo ghāsam esāno araññe odahī visam.
ja366:2.1: Madhū 'ti maññamānā ye taṃ visaṃ samāsāsisuṃ tesaṃ taṃ kaṭukaṃ āsi, maraṇaṃ ten' upāgamuṃ.
ja366:3.1: Ye ca kho paṭisaṃkhāya visaṃ taṃ parivajjayuṃ te āturesu sukhitā ḍayhamānesu nibbutā.
ja366:4.1: Evam eva manussesu visaṃ kāmā samohitā āmisaṃ bandhanaṃ c' etaṃ maccuveso guhāsayo.
ja366:5.1: Evam eva ime kāme āturā paricārake ye sadā parivajjenti saṃgaṃ loke upaccagun ti.
